230.title: It Took 3,700 People to Find Where This Minecraft Picture Was Taken 🌍 pack.png #Shorts
230.desc:
pack.png, the default resource pack icon, sat in Minecraft for about 10 years and nobody knew which world it came from. After SalC1's 2020 video, about 3,700 Minecraft@Home volunteers searched every seed with their computers, and found it in September 2020 in one of the last seeds they checked (seed 3257840388504953787).
What Minecraft mystery should we cover next? 👇
8-Bit Backstory #230, Minecraft. Clips: SalC1; Minecraft@Home (YouTube).
